label: startup_clear_sram_byte
purpose: Clear the next byte in the bootloader SRAM context.

label: startup_check_sram_end
purpose: Repeat SRAM clearing until X reaches 0x012C.

label: usb_crc16_next_byte
purpose: Read a byte and mix it into the CRC accumulator.

label: usb_crc16_shift_bit
purpose: Shift the CRC and conditionally apply polynomial 0xA001.

label: usb_crc16_advance_bit_count
purpose: Advance the packed eight-bit CRC loop counter.

label: usb_crc16_check_remaining_bytes
purpose: Process remaining bytes or append the two CRC bytes.

label: usb_rx_wait_for_j
purpose: Wait for the USB J state with a bounded sync counter.

label: usb_rx_wait_for_k
purpose: Sample for the next J-to-K sync transition.

label: usb_rx_found_k
purpose: Prepare the receive pointer and test for two consecutive K bits.

label: usb_rx_sync_confirmed
purpose: Initialize receive state while preserving the first-bit sample phase.

label: usb_rx_unstuff_bit6
purpose: Handle stuffing detected at receive bit 6 and adjust the timing accumulator.

label: usb_rx_unstuff_bit7
purpose: Resample data bit 7 after a stuffed bit and adjust timing.

label: usb_rx_unstuff_even_bit
purpose: Resample an even data bit and detect SE0.

label: usb_rx_unstuff_even_resume_jump
purpose: Keep the two-cycle jump into the even-bit resume path.

label: usb_rx_unstuff_odd_bit
purpose: Resample an odd data bit and detect SE0.

label: usb_rx_unstuff_odd_resume_jump
purpose: Keep the two-cycle jump into the odd-bit resume path.

label: usb_rx_decode_bit6
purpose: Decode bit 6 and compensate fractional receive timing.

label: usb_rx_shift_bit6
purpose: Shift the decoded bit-6 value into the receive register.

label: usb_rx_sample_bit7
purpose: Sample bit 7 and check whether bit 6 required unstuffing.

label: usb_rx_finish_byte
purpose: Check bit-7 stuffing and store the reconstructed byte.

label: usb_rx_sample_even_bit
purpose: Sample and decode data bit 0 or 2 or 4.

label: usb_rx_shift_stuff_mask
purpose: Advance the reconstruction mask after an even bit.

label: usb_rx_sample_odd_bit
purpose: Sample and decode data bit 1 or 3 or 5 and detect SE0.

label: usb_rx_advance_bit_pair
purpose: Advance the receive bit-pair counter or finish the byte.

label: usb_rx_overflow
purpose: Clear the pending USB edge after receive-buffer overflow.

label: usb_rx_ignore_packet
purpose: Discard an unsupported or misaddressed packet by clearing its token.

label: usb_rx_end_packet
purpose: Recover packet start after SE0 and dispatch its PID.

label: usb_rx_handle_setup_or_out
purpose: Start waiting for the DATA packet following SETUP or OUT.

label: usb_rx_wait_for_data
purpose: Wait for a pending USB edge or the short DATA timeout.

label: usb_rx_store_token
purpose: Publish the current token in the USB SRAM context.

label: usb_handler_packet_done
purpose: Restore the packet counter and receive another pending packet if needed.

label: usb_handler_return
purpose: Restore Y and return from the polled USB handler.

label: usb_rx_handle_data
purpose: Accept DATA0 or DATA1 or send NAK when the receive buffer is occupied.

label: usb_rx_handle_in
purpose: Choose queued endpoint-zero data or a handshake for an IN token.

label: usb_tx_stuff_regular_bit
purpose: Insert a stuffed zero during transmission of data bits 0 through 5.

label: usb_tx_stuff_regular_delay
purpose: Preserve the stuffed-bit output timing before resuming transmission.

label: usb_tx_stuff_bit6
purpose: Handle the bit-6 stuffing path and compensate the shift register.

label: usb_tx_stuff_bit7
purpose: Reset stuffing history and resume the bit-7 output path.

label: usb_tx_send_nak
purpose: Select the NAK handshake PID.

label: usb_tx_send_ack
purpose: Select the ACK handshake PID.

label: usb_tx_send_count_handshake
purpose: Use the handshake PID already held in the packet counter.

label: usb_tx_prepare_handshake
purpose: Point Y at the handshake register and set the two-byte transmit count.

label: usb_tx_acquire_bus
purpose: Drive the USB pins and initialize NRZI transmission including SYNC.

label: usb_tx_begin_byte
purpose: Initialize the packed transmit bit counter for the next byte.

label: usb_tx_send_regular_bit
purpose: Emit the next NRZI bit for data bits 0 through 5.

label: usb_tx_check_regular_stuffing
purpose: Check the six-one history and advance the regular-bit loop.

label: usb_tx_send_bit6
purpose: Emit data bit 6 and handle its stuffing history.

label: usb_tx_send_bit7
purpose: Emit data bit 7 and advance to the next byte or end of packet.

label: usb_tx_finish_eop
purpose: Clear the TX-generated pending edge and prepare bus release after SE0.

label: usb_tx_eop_delay
purpose: Hold the required end-of-packet interval before releasing the USB pins.

label: flash_buffer_append_word
purpose: Protect the RESET word then stage one word in the Flash page buffer.

label: flash_buffer_load_word
purpose: Execute page-buffer SPM and advance the current address by two bytes.

label: usb_disconnect_delay_outer
purpose: Reload the inner counter for the initial USB disconnect delay.

label: usb_disconnect_delay_inner
purpose: Count down one inner USB disconnect delay interval.

label: bootloader_poll_begin
purpose: Initialize the five-millisecond USB poll and host-reset counters.

label: usb_poll_sample_bus
purpose: Sample both USB lines and rearm reset detection outside SE0.

label: usb_poll_check_reset_duration
purpose: Detect sustained SE0 and clear the active and pending USB addresses.

label: usb_poll_check_packet_pending
purpose: Call the bit-level handler when a USB pin-change edge is pending.

label: bootloader_process_pending_command
purpose: Service the watchdog and execute a queued application erase.

label: flash_erase_application_page
purpose: Erase application pages in reverse order down through page zero.

label: bootloader_dispatch_command
purpose: Dispatch page commit or application exit while preserving pending work.

label: flash_commit_buffered_page
purpose: Bounds-check and write the staged page using a page-aligned SPM address.

label: bootloader_clear_command
purpose: Clear the completed or unrecognized queued command.

label: usb_control_process_received_packet
purpose: Check the received payload and dispatch a complete eight-byte SETUP.

label: bootloader_handle_vendor_request
purpose: Refresh the idle timeout and handle device info or legacy Flash commands.

label: usb_reply_limit_length
purpose: Clamp the prepared reply length to the host-requested wLength.

label: usb_reply_store_length
purpose: Publish the number of remaining control-reply bytes.

label: usb_rx_release_buffer
purpose: Mark the received packet buffer available for the next packet.

label: usb_tx_prepare_pending_reply
purpose: Build a control-IN block when TX is idle and reply bytes remain.

label: usb_tx_prepare_data_packet
purpose: Update remaining length and toggle DATA0 or DATA1 for the next block.

label: usb_tx_copy_flash_payload
purpose: Copy reply bytes from Flash to the endpoint-zero transmit buffer.

label: usb_tx_append_payload_crc
purpose: Append CRC16 and mark the end of a short control reply.

label: usb_tx_publish_packet_length
purpose: Publish the prepared TX block length including protocol overhead.

label: bootloader_check_idle_timeout
purpose: Increment idle polls and start the application at timeout if present.

label: usb_poll_resynchronize
purpose: Enter the post-poll resynchronization path with LED code omitted.

label: legacy_led_off_anchor
purpose: Retain a zero-byte anchor where the removed LED-off code used to be.

label: usb_poll_check_missed_packet
purpose: Check whether USB traffic arrived during command and reply processing.

label: usb_poll_wait_for_idle
purpose: Wait for a quiet USB interval before accepting the next packet.

label: usb_poll_advance_timeout
purpose: Continue the bus-poll loop until its timeout expires.

label: bootloader_poll_timeout
purpose: Continue with queued commands after the bus-poll timeout.

label: bootloader_start_application
purpose: Release USB and preserve reset flags before jumping to the application.

label: bootloader_check_set_flash_address
purpose: Recognize the legacy page-transfer command and check the current address.

label: flash_set_address_and_clear_buffer
purpose: Load the requested page address and clear the temporary page buffer.

label: usb_reply_empty
purpose: Return a zero-length control reply through the common length limiter.

label: bootloader_check_write_flash_word_pair
purpose: Recognize the four-byte Flash-data request and queue full-page commits.

label: bootloader_queue_command
purpose: Store the low six request bits as a deferred bootloader command.

label: usb_dispatch_extended_or_standard_request
purpose: Check EEPROM and Flash extensions before the standard-request fallback.

label: usb_standard_dispatch
purpose: Handle standard endpoint-zero requests after the extension checks.

label: usb_reply_use_scratch_buffer
purpose: Select the shared response scratch buffer at SRAM 0x010A.

label: usb_reply_set_pointer
purpose: Store the prepared response pointer and continue with length limiting.

label: usb_standard_check_set_address
purpose: Handle SET_ADDRESS or continue standard-request dispatch.

label: usb_standard_check_get_descriptor
purpose: Choose the device or configuration descriptor for GET_DESCRIPTOR.

label: usb_standard_check_configuration
purpose: Dispatch GET_CONFIGURATION and SET_CONFIGURATION.

label: usb_standard_check_get_interface
purpose: Return the default interface byte or an empty unsupported-request reply.

label: usb_standard_get_configuration
purpose: Prepare a one-byte reply pointing at the current USB configuration.

label: usb_reply_pointer_trampoline
purpose: Jump to the common response-pointer stores after configuration setup.

label: legacy_led_on_anchor
purpose: Retain a zero-byte anchor where the removed LED-on code used to be.
